verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms project-local skill files (e.g., `.claude/skills/deploy/SKILL.md`) committed alongside code, and plugins/marketplaces that can be shared across projects and teams, but there is no explicit documentation of a user-global (e.g., home-directory) skills location or a scope toggle comparable to project-local. missing for 10: explicit docs on a user-global skills directory/setting, and confirmation that the same skill can be installed either locally or globally by choice.
